content:
Treat https://ivxholding.com and https://api.ivxholding.com as the production source of truth.

Do not use rork-global-real-estate-invest1.onrender.com as the primary health check unless it is explicitly configured as the public production endpoint.

Verify production by checking:

1. GitHub HEAD SHA
2. https://api.ivxholding.com/health
3. https://api.ivxholding.com/version
4. APK version
5. Owner login
6. Member registration
7. Member login
8. Investment APIs

If the raw Render hostname returns 404 but the custom domains are healthy, document that as expected configuration rather than a deployment failure.

If the Render hostname is expected to be public, inspect the Render dashboard and routing configuration to determine why it returns 404.
